## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting user behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

For structural changes, explain the responsibility being moved and why. Identify
public interface, configuration, migration or frozen-runtime implications.

## Verification

- Exact commands run and observed evidence/artifacts:
- Relevant unit, integration or system coverage:
- Residual risk, missing checks or decisions:

For UI changes, identify the applicable rules in `design.md`, the behavior
covered by regression tests, and desktop/mobile screenshot evidence reviewed.
When replacing a locally patched deployment, identify the recovered fixes and
any requested work still outside this PR. Report the merge revision and served
asset verification after deployment; local startup alone is not merge evidence.

## Documentation and compatibility

Link updated usage/design documentation where applicable. For dependency or
asset changes, retain upstream notices and identify the authoritative source.
